Ammo Reloading: Dies, Shell Holders & Plates
rules: imperium_rule (PROHIBITS): 1613 - Ammo Reloading: Shell Holders & Plates - P1

subcategories: Ammunition reloading plates, shells, and holders
guidelines: Specific ammo dies, shell holders, and plates, are prohibited because they are intended to be used for pistol and assault rifle caliber products.
rules: policy_rule (PROHIBITS): Ammunition dies plates only prohibit the following calibers: .223, 224, 25, 5.7, 32, 357, 380, 40, 44, 45, 460, 480 judge, 5.56mm, 7.62x39mm, 9mm, 300 Blackout.

policy_rule (PROHIBITS): Shell holders and plates only prohibit the following law calibers (from off channel): .223, 224, 25, 5.7, 32, 357, 380, 40, 44, 45, 460, 480 judge, 5.56mm, 7.62x39mm, 9mm, 300 Blackout.
policy_rule (ALLOWS): Ammunition dies not listed within the prohibited section are allowed.
policy_rule (ALLOWS): Shell holders for firearms are allowed.
policy_rule (ALLOWS): Cleaning brushes for firearms are allowed.

policy_rule (ALLOWS): Reloading kit items such as bullet pullers, case trimmers, case tumblers, cleaning brushes, depriming and priming tools, hand presses, neck turners, speed loaders and sifters, and sandbags are allowed.
